function.description: Read one UTF-8 workspace text file. Send exactly one JSON object with path and optional one-based line offset and limit. path must be a real file you have already seen in an ls, find, grep, or search result; read never accepts a directory, a glob, or a filename you inferred from a language or framework convention. Returns raw file text with original line endings and no line-number prefixes. If a result is partial, continue with the reported nextOffset.
function.name: read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

offset.description: One-based line offset to begin reading.

path.description: One exact workspace-relative file path, copied character for character from a listing or search result. Not a directory, not a pattern, never a guessed name.

function.description: List one workspace directory non-recursively. Entries are returned in lexical order with / on directories. Use find for recursion. Continue with nextOffset when truncated.
function.name: ls

path.description: One exact workspace-relative directory path, or "." for the workspace root. Not a file and not a pattern; ls has no glob argument.

function.description: Find workspace paths by one explicit glob under path. The two arguments split the shell form: the directory goes in path and the pattern goes in glob, so docs/*.md is {"path":"docs","glob":"*.md"}. Returns stable sorted relative paths. No fuzzy query language.
function.name: find

glob.description: One include glob, matched against both the workspace-relative path and the file name. Examples: **/*.rs, *.md, README*.

path.description: Existing workspace-relative directory to search under. Use "." for the workspace root. The pattern belongs in glob, never here.

function.description: Search text with one pattern in literal or regex mode under path. path is the directory scope and glob is the optional filename filter, so "grep foo in internal/model/*.go" is {"pattern":"foo","mode":"literal","path":"internal/model","glob":"*.go"}. Optional caseSensitive, context lines, and limit. Returns path:line: text rows.
function.name: grep

glob.description: Optional include glob such as *.go, matched against both the workspace-relative path and the file name.

path.description: Existing workspace-relative file or directory to search under. Use "." for the workspace root. The filename pattern belongs in glob, never here.

function.description: Locate workspace paths or content from a warm index. Prefer this over grep for finding where something lives. path mode ranks files and directories by name; content mode returns path:line: text rows for a literal match. Matching is case-insensitive unless query contains an uppercase character. Use grep for regex or context lines. Narrow path, glob, or query when a result is truncated.
function.name: search

glob.description: Optional include glob such as *.md, matched against both the workspace-relative path and the file name.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 100 for path and 50 for content.

mode.description: path ranks file and directory names; content searches inside files.

path.description: Existing workspace-relative file or directory to search under. Use "." for the workspace root. The filename pattern belongs in glob, never here.

query.description: Name fragment for path mode, or exact literal text for content mode.

function.description: Create or replace one workspace text file after permission. Send exactly path and content. Parents are created after approval; the write is staged and installed atomically.
function.name: write

function.description: Apply one or more exact replacements to one workspace file after permission. Send exactly path and edits[]. Each oldText must match the same original snapshot uniquely and without overlap. Copy oldText verbatim from the latest read result, including its line endings. No fuzzy matching.
function.name: edit

edits.description: Exact replacements to apply to one original snapshot.

function.description: Apply one exact Begin Patch document to workspace files after permission. Send exactly the patch field. Every hunk must match uniquely. Do not send edit fields.
function.name: apply_patch

patch.description: A complete *** Begin Patch through *** End Patch document.

function.description: Run a local workspace command in /bin/sh after policy and permission checks. Prefer search to locate code, read to open it, and ls or find for listing; use grep only for exact regex or context lines. Do not shell out to ripgrep or find for routine search. Optional timeoutMs has a bounded default and maximum. Output progress is coalesced; large output keeps the useful tail and remains retrievable by context hash. Send exactly command and optional timeoutMs. Do not send programId or args.
function.name: command

function.description: Run one approved executable by id without shell lookup. Send exactly programId, optional args, and optional timeoutMs. Put one argument value in each args item. Do not repeat the executable name, use shell operators, or send a command field.
function.name: run_program

args.description: Argument values only, in process order. Do not include the executable id.

programId.description: One exact executable id from this enum.

function.description: Retrieve a bounded window of exact compacted local tool output by its reported hash. Returns context_not_available when no output has been compacted yet.
function.name: retrieve_context

hash.description: The hash reported by a compacted tool result.
